title: Fervor
overview: In a desolate desert landscape, a determined young Latina woman confronts her antagonist, unveiling intricate layers of her personal history. Through the narrative of two brothers' lives in a remote village, she unveils themes of destiny, survival, and the impact of violence. As the story unfolds, tensions rise, and Fernanda's dark mission becomes clearer, leaving both characters and viewers grappling with the harsh realities of their circumstances.
